desc:
An AI shopping assistant that helps shoppers choose asks a few simple questions and recommends products from your own catalog. Ecom Swift LLC adds it to your store, so undecided visitors get a short reason for each suggestion and a link to the page.

## What is a shopping assistant for an online store?

A shopping assistant is a guide on your store that talks with the shopper. It asks about budget, use and preferences, then suggests items from your catalog and explains why each one fits. It can also put two products side by side and answer simple questions about sizes or materials.

Think of it as the helpful person at the shop counter, available on every page and at any hour. It works only from your product data, so it recommends items you sell and nothing else.

## Why choice itself becomes a barrier

A large catalog sounds like an advantage, but too many similar options make people stall. A shopper looking for a first backpack or a gift cannot easily judge the differences between twenty near identical items, and they cannot ask a person. Many close the tab and plan to come back, then do not.

Guided selling reduces that effort. A few questions narrow the list, and a short reason, such as "light enough for daily commuting", replaces a table of specifications. Whether this lifts sales depends on your products, prices and traffic, but it removes a clear cause of hesitation.

## What a good assistant includes

- A small set of guiding questions that fit your products, such as budget, use or recipient.
- Recommendations drawn only from products you actually sell.
- A short reason shown with each recommendation.
- A link straight to each product page.
- Side by side comparison of two items.
- Stock awareness, so out of stock items are not offered.
- Answers to simple questions about size, materials and care, based on your product data.
- Styling that matches your brand colors, name and tone.
- Bundle and add-on suggestions where they genuinely fit.
- Basic tracking of clicks and add to carts, so you see what it does.

## How we build it

We begin with your product data and a conversation about how customers choose. The questions come from your own sales: what shoppers ask in emails, which products are confused with each other and which choices lead to returns.

We then prepare the product information the assistant reads, choose the questions and test the answers with realistic requests. A request that does not fit anything in your catalog gets an honest reply and a pointer to your contact page, not an invented product.

The Basic package adds a simple guide with a few questions and links to product pages. The Standard package adds comparison, stock awareness and brand styling. The Premium package covers a larger range, adds bundles, sizing and fit help, tracks clicks and add to carts, and includes two rounds of tuning after testing. Add-ons such as a quiz page or a gift finder flow extend the same idea.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Keep product data accurate and up to date, especially stock and sizes.
- Choose questions that shoppers can answer in a few seconds.
- Review the assistant's conversations in the first weeks and adjust.
- Place it where shoppers hesitate, such as collection and product pages.
- Offer a clear route to a real person for complex questions.

**Avoid:**
- Asking more than a handful of questions before showing products.
- Letting it discuss topics unrelated to your store.
- Hiding the contact page behind the assistant.
- Promising the assistant will lift sales by a set amount.
- Feeding it outdated prices or discontinued items.

## Who this is for

It suits a store with a wide range, such as gifts, outdoor gear or skincare, where shoppers often ask which one to pick. It suits an owner who answers the same "which should I buy" emails every day. It also suits a brand that wants a lighter alternative to a full quiz funnel.

## What we need from you

Send a product export, your policies and a list of the questions customers ask most. Tell us which products matter most and which should never be recommended together. We never need your password: access to your store is given as a collaborator, staff or developer user, and we explain exactly where the assistant will appear before it goes live.
